brief.question: How should mid-market B2B software vendors price and govern AI features that call third-party frontier models when vendor margins and customer data-residency clauses conflict through 2027?
brief.audience: Mid-market SaaS product, pricing, and legal leads.
brief.scope: Synthetic source pack only (same as Day-2 / 2026-10-15 original-condition retest). Cover margin vs residency, contracting patterns, options/kill-criteria through 2027. Distinct from open-weight lock-in. No live web. Change = Toolkit 1.1.0→1.3.0.
brief.output: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): margin vs residency, contracting patterns, counter-evidence, options/kill-criteria. Registries/checklist separate.
brief.depth: Lite original-condition retest (version regression); long-form commercial mechanism memo.
brief.evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; disclose fictional evidence; disclose no independent review.
